text:
Add GBrain memory to this existing agent. Read and follow:
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/garrytan/gbrain/master/INSTALL_FOR_AGENTS.md
Keep my current identity and instructions, start keyless, and show me the
search-mode choice. Verify a remember/recall round trip with real GBrain calls.

Install gbrain release v0.60.734.0 (`github:garrytan/gbrain#v0.60.734.0`) wherever the docs say #stable.
reply_text:
GBrain v0.60.734.0 is installed and wired into Claude Code as keyless memory. The remember/recall round trip passed using real GBrain calls.

**What changed**
- I installed Bun 1.4.4, then `bun install -g github:garrytan/gbrain#v0.60.734.0` (commit `a278ddf`). `gbrain --version` reports 0.60.734.0.
- `gbrain setup claude-code` created a local PGLite brain at `~/.gbrain/brain.pglite`. It has no API keys, no embeddings and no paid providers.
- It registered a `gbrain` MCP server at user scope. `claude mcp get gbrain` shows it as ✔ Connected.
- It added two read-only context hooks (SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit) to `settings.json`. Your existing `apiKeyHelper` and other settings are unchanged. No capture hooks were added. Backups of your original config are in `/tmp/gbrain-backup/`.
- **Your identity and instructions are kept.** You had no `CLAUDE.md` before. Setup created one that contains only a short "check GBrain first" block between gbrain markers. No identity, personal-agent bootstrap, cron, daemon or services were set up.

**Verification**
1. Setup's own check passed: initialize, tools/list (8 tools) and recall all answered.
2. `gbrain remember` saved an install-check marker as fact #1, with provenance `install-check`.
3. A separate CLI process found it with `recall --entity install-check` and with an exact keyword search (`recall --grep <ref>`).
4. I started the same MCP server command Claude Code uses (`gbrain serve`) and called `recall` through it. It returned the exact marker text.
5. `gbrain doctor --only harness_wiring` gives a warning (`registration_unverified`). This session started before gbrain was registered, so it can't see the new MCP tools; the registration itself checks out. Restart Claude Code to load the gbrain tools. To finish the new-session check, ask me to recall `install-check`, then remove the marker with `gbrain forget 1`. I left the marker in place so that check can still run.

**Search mode: `conservative` is in effect.** It was chosen automatically because there's no chat key and no reranker. You can change it any time:

```
Estimated downstream input cost of the retrieved payload @ 10K queries/mo:

                  Haiku 5.5     Sonnet 5.5    Opus 5.5
                  ($0.10/M in)  ($2/M in)     ($4/M in)
  conservative    $4/mo         $80/mo        $160/mo
  balanced        $10/mo        $200/mo       $400/mo
  tokenmax        $20/mo        $400/mo       $800/mo

  Assumed payload per query: conservative 4K, balanced 10K, tokenmax 20K tokens.
  Scales linearly: x10 for 100K queries/mo, /10 for 1K. 200x corner-to-corner spread.
  Embedding, reranking and query expansion are separate provider charges.
```

1. **conservative** (current): 4K token budget, at most 10 chunks, no reranker. Best for Haiku-class subagents, cost-sensitive setups and high-volume loops.
2. **balanced**: 12K budget, 25 chunks, reranked. The reranker needs a provider key.
3. **tokenmax**: no budget limit, 50 chunks, reranked. The widest retrieval; it's the recommended mode once a chat key is set.

To switch, run `gbrain config set search.mode <mode>`, then check it with `gbrain search modes`. Query expansion is off by default in every mode. These are estimates of what the retrieved text costs your downstream model, not GBrain prices.

**Other settings in effect**
- **Automatic saving (writeback):** off, so I only save what you ask me to remember. GBrain recommends `salient`, which saves durable facts you state, with their source.
- **Conversation archive:** on. It keeps one redacted page per conversation per day, and without an embedding key nothing leaves this machine. Turn it off with `gbrain transcripts archive off`.
- **Upkeep:** free upkeep runs while a gbrain session is open. Turn it off with `gbrain config set maintenance.auto false`.
- **Starter pages:** none. If you want a personal or company brain, `gbrain setup claude-code --shape personal|company` adds them.
- **Search quality:** search is keyword-only for now. Semantic search needs an embedding key, such as Voyage, and your consent.

There's also a hosted option, gbrain.io, which runs the brain for you and can import this one.
